meta.title: fix: resolve ESLint warnings by replacing img tags with Next.js Image
meta.body_summary: Replace with Next.js Image in four components to satisfy @next/next/no-img-element ESLint rule, improving LCP and bandwidth via automatic image optimization.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced img with Next.js Image across 4 files; merged after addressing Copilot's fill prop suggestion and fixing CSS typo; ESLint compliance and narrative performance benefits claimed.

core_change_summary.description: Replace tags with Next.js Image in four components: main page recipe icons, header avatar, image uploader preview, and shifu-setting avatar. Added width/height or fill props, and used window.Image to avoid conflict with Next.js Image.
